subject: McGlynn and Andrews HVAC Project Bond
overview: The committee approved a $25.7 million bond for comprehensive HVAC replacements at the McGlynn and Andrews schools and revised graduation policy language regarding math requirements and ceremony eligibility. They also reviewed the recruitment process for two senior administrative roles and presented a gubernatorial citation to a principal for her response to a school fire.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to conduct strategy for contract negotiations with non-union personnel, specifically nine school principals.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Member Graham shared information regarding the upcoming MASC annual Day on the Hill scheduled for May 6.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine business including bills, payrolls, grants, field trips, and meeting minutes from March 24, 2025.

items.title: Governor’s Citation Presentation
items.summary: Principal Jennifer Skane received a citation from the Governor's office for her heroic efforts in extinguishing a fire at the Andrews Middle School on February 11.

items.title: Central Office Search Processes
items.summary: Dr. Galusi outlined the recruitment plans for the Assistant Superintendent of Academics and Director of English Learners, noting that both processes will involve stakeholder surveys and search committees.

items.title: Policy IKF Graduation Requirements Update
items.summary: Approved a first reading of policy updates clarifying math pathway requirements by graduation year and ensuring students receiving certificates of completion can participate in ceremonies.

items.title: McGlynn and Andrews HVAC Project Bond Request
items.summary: Approved a bond request of $25,775,000 to fund the replacement of HVAC systems at the McGlynn and Andrews schools, including necessary ADA upgrades and roof refurbishments. The committee discussed seeking variances for non-essential ADA changes and the potential for adding solar arrays if the project remains under budget.

items.title: Resolution on Health and Physical Education Requirements
items.summary: Approved a resolution directing the administration to recommend policy changes by June 2025 to increase graduation flexibility regarding health and physical education requirements.

items.title: Condolences
items.summary: The committee recognized the passing of retired teacher Louise C. Jordan, school carpenter Anthony DeLuca, and William Shane Horty.
